task_completion.description: Load both PDB structures (4HHB and 1HHO) into the molecular visualization software.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The object list in the PyMOL/molecular viewer GUI shows both '4HHB' and '1HHO' entries.

task_completion.description: Isolate or select the alpha subunits from both the T-state and R-state structures.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Selection indicators (e.g., pink dots or highlighted rows) or command history showing selection of chain A from both structures.

task_completion.description: Perform a structural alignment/superposition of the alpha subunits.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 3D viewer shows two protein structures overlapping closely; the command output area displays an alignment calculation or RMSD value.

task_completion.description: Create a high-quality overlay figure and save it to the specified path.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A file browser or terminal command showing 'hemo_superposition.png' exists in '~/PyMOL_Data/images/'. The image itself should show the superimposed alpha subunits.

task_completion.description: Write a report documenting the RMSD and structural changes to the specified text file.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor or 'cat' command output showing 'hemo_rmsd_report.txt' in '~/PyMOL_Data/' containing a numerical RMSD value and descriptive text.

integrity.description: The agent interacted with the PyMOL/molecular viewer GUI rather than just creating files via script.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the PyMOL application window active with the structures loaded in the 3D viewport.

integrity.description: The RMSD value in the report should come from the software calculation, not just pre-known values.
integrity.visual_evidence: The RMSD value in the report matches the value displayed in the PyMOL/software command log.

integrity.description: The agent saved files to the specific requested directories, not default locations.
integrity.visual_evidence: The file paths in the GUI 'Save' dialogs or terminal commands match '~/PyMOL_Data/images/hemo_superposition.png' and '~/PyMOL_Data/hemo_rmsd_report.txt'.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The T-state is 4HHB (deoxy) and the R-state is 1HHO (oxy). A successful alignment of the alpha subunits (Chain A) should yield an RMSD value typically between 0.1 and 6.0 Angstroms (physically expected around 0.7-0.8A). The figure must be saved to /home/ga/PyMOL_Data/images/hemo_superposition.png and the report to /home/ga/PyMOL_Data/hemo_rmsd_report.txt. The figure file size should be at least 30,000 bytes to be considered publication quality.
